svg.aria-label: Left: in float32 the naive cross-entropy follows the stable curve until z is about 17, then sigmoid rounds to one and the loss becomes infinite, while logaddexp keeps growing linearly. Right: relative error of log(1+x) rises towards 100 percent as x shrinks below 1e-16, while log1p stays at rounding level
